text:
Devin Ramos: Quick sync: Acme's security team filed a questionnaire and wants full SOC2/ISO excerpts, a signed pen-test authorization, and a secure copy of redacted evidence. They also asked whether we allow an external red-team to run scans from their IPs or prefer us to broker with a vendor. They want pricing for a 10-day dedicated POC with air-gapped staging.

Priya Singh: We can provide redacted SOC2 sections + ISO control mappings. For full reports we require an NDA and an evidence access request form. I can prep a redacted zip and a presigned S3 link scoped to 72h.

Tom Becker: For pen-test: legal must sign off on scope. We typically require the signed pen-test letter before any scanning. If Acme wants to run their own external scans, we need their vendor details and cert of insurance. Otherwise, we can schedule our approved vendor and share a test window.

Maya Rivera: Operational notes: air-gapped POC usually runs in a private subnet with a bastion and an outbound proxy that we lock down. We prefer SFTP transfer for large evidence bundles. If presigned S3 is easier for them, include a short curl example in the handoff docs.

sec-bot: Evidence delivery endpoints: https://internal.s3.redwood/assurance/ (presigned links available). Pen-test template: https://redwood.internal/security/pen-test-template.pdf :lock:

Devin Ramos: Priya can you prepare the presigned bundle and the evidence index? Also please capture which artifacts are redacted and why (PII, third-party infra).

Priya Singh: Will do. Drafting the evidence index now and will mark redactions. Upload ETA: today EOD. Presigned link TTL: 72h unless they request SFTP.

Tom Becker: For the scanning scope: ask whether they need network-level or app-level tests. If network-level only we can provide a CIDR allowlist. If app-level (auth, L7), we need session creds and a PKI contact. We'll add recommended rate limits and safe hours to the pen-test letter.

Maya Rivera: Pricing: a 10-day dedicated POC with on-prem packaging has three components: one-time onboarding (engineer-days + travel if needed), provisional infra reservation, and a support SLA add-on. Ballpark add = $8k-$18k depending on travel and engineering hours. I'll prep a line-item estimate.

Devin Ramos: Customer also asks if we can do a separate 'no-external-egress' option during the POC. How do we handle updates/patches?

Tom Becker: We can block external egress but then must allowlist update servers (OS/package repos) temporarily. Recommend a maintenance schedule and providing a yarn/apt mirror list up front.

Priya Singh: Uploading: presigned evidence bundle (redacted) -> https://s3.redwood/presigned/acme/evidence_redacted_v1.zip (expires in 72h). Also attached the completed questionnaire answers doc: https://s3.redwood/presigned/acme/sec_questionnaire_answers_v1.pdf

sec-bot: Pen-test letter (template copy) uploaded to legal queue: https://redwood.internal/legal/pen_test_request_2987654321.docx

legal: We need Acme to sign clause 4.2 (exfil proofing) and confirm vendor insurance. Will draft a minimal change to the template to speed this.

Maya Rivera: I posted provisional cost estimate in #sales-estimates and linked it in the shared drive. Devin, flag me if we need to include travel.

Devin Ramos: Thanks all. Next steps: legal finalize pen-test letter and send to Acme for signature; Priya confirm SFTP vs presigned preference; Tom finalize CIDRs and update servers list to allowlist; Maya finalize estimate. If we get signed pen-test letter this week we can schedule a 72h evidence handoff + 10-day POC starting in two weeks.

Priya Singh: I'll ping Acme contact (security@acme.com) for SFTP host and preferred transfer method.

Tom Becker: CIDR payload example to send to customer:

``
We require the following allowlist entries for the test window:
- 203.0.113.0/28 (Acme scanner)
- 198.51.100.12 (Acme vendor NAT)
Please confirm timezone and exact test times.
``

Devin Ramos: Perfect. Tagging legal and sec-bot once more. Priya/Maya/Tom please update thread when items are uploaded/sent.

sec-bot: Reminder: any signed pen-test letter must be saved to the assurance vault after signature.
